story: As a CS agent, I want to sign in with my company SSO, so that I don't manage another password [shipped]
As a CS agent, I want to find a transaction by ID, so that I can resolve a customer ticket fast [shipped]
outcome: I can resolve a customer ticket fast [shipped]

story: As a CS agent, I want to find transactions by customer email, so that I can find the right charge when the customer doesn't have an ID [in-progress]
outcome: I can find the right charge when the customer doesn't have an ID [in-progress]

story: As a CS agent, I want to view full transaction details, so that I can confirm I'm refunding the right charge [in-progress]
outcome: I can confirm I'm refunding the right charge [in-progress]

story: As a CS agent, I want to submit refunds under $100 with rule-based auto-approve, so that small refunds clear instantly without a queue [started]
outcome: small refunds clear instantly without a queue [started]

story: As a CS agent, I want to submit refunds over $100 into the approval queue, so that supervisors can sanity-check before money moves [not-started]
outcome: supervisors can sanity-check before money moves [not-started]

story: As a refund approver, I want a dashboard of pending refunds, so that I can clear the queue without hunting for individual cases [not-started]
outcome: I can clear the queue without hunting for individual cases [not-started]

story: As a customer, I want an email when my refund is approved, so that I know the money is on the way [in-progress]
outcome: I know the money is on the way [in-progress]

story: As an approver, I want a Slack ping when a refund needs my review, so that I don't miss queued items [not-started]
As a CS agent, I want failed refunds to retry automatically, so that intermittent payment-provider blips don't become support escalations [not-started]
outcome: intermittent payment-provider blips don't become support escalations [not-started]

story: Emit audit log events for every refund action, so that auditors can reconstruct decisions [in-progress]
As a compliance reviewer, I want to search the audit log by case/user/date, so that I can answer auditor questions without engineering [not-started]
outcome: I can answer auditor questions without engineering [not-started]

story: Enforce SOC 2 audit log retention policy (7 years), so that the audit trail is admissible [not-started]
As a compliance officer, I want to export the audit log to CSV, so that I can hand evidence to the auditor [not-started]
outcome: I can hand evidence to the auditor [not-started]

story: As a security engineer, I want suspicious refund clusters to fire an alert, so that we catch internal fraud or compromised accounts early [not-started]
outcome: we catch internal fraud or compromised accounts early [not-started]

story: As an enterprise IT admin, I want a SCIM 2.0 endpoint scaffolded with auth, so that my IdP can discover the provisioning API
outcome: my IdP can discover the provisioning API

story: As an enterprise IT admin, I want to create and update users via SCIM, so that new hires get refund-portal access automatically
outcome: new hires get refund-portal access automatically

story: As an enterprise IT admin, I want SCIM DELETE to disable access immediately, so that offboarded employees lose portal access (also closes a SOC 2 control)
outcome: offboarded employees lose portal access (also closes a SOC 2 control)

story: As an enterprise IT admin, I want my IdP group memberships to map to refund-portal roles, so that I don't manually re-assign permissions per user
outcome: I don't manually re-assign permissions per user
